Messages.Author: Peter D Bakija
Messages.Body:
So Jerry, the Blood Brother, has the following ability:

Chicago Circle : During your master phase, you may move any amount of blood
from the Blood Brothers in the Chicago Circle to any other Blood Brothers in
this circle. Sterile.

Can Jerry move his blood to an *uncontrolled* Blood Brother of the same
circle?

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
On Sun, 29 Feb 2004 08:50:46 -0500, Peter D Bakija
<pd...@lightlink.com> wrote:

>So Jerry, the Blood Brother, has the following ability:

>Chicago Circle : During your master phase, you may move any amount of blood
>from the Blood Brothers in the Chicago Circle to any other Blood Brothers in
>this circle. Sterile.

>Can Jerry move his blood to an *uncontrolled* Blood Brother of the same
>circle?

No.

Uncontrolled vampires are not legal targets for any effect without
specific card text.

Jerry lacks such card text.

1.6.1.5 of the online rulebook

Targets. If a card is played on another card, or selects or chooses or
otherwise targets another card, the target card must be in play (i.e.,
controlled). Vampires in the torpor region are eligible targets by
default, but vampires in the uncontrolled region and contested cards
are not.

http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/rulebook/

Carpe noctem.

Lasombra

http://www.TheLasombra.com

>always the possibility that there was some sort of kooky clarification I

However, keep in mind that Jerry's special works on vampires in torpor,
and also works even if HE is in torpor.

Jerry's special is highly underrated at first glance; and that's even
when you think it's a strong special to begin with. You really have to
play with it a few times to appreciate just how good being able to
rearrange things as you need for your turn is.

Yes, Jerry's special is amazing in terms of blood management.

Also note that it can be used on Chicago Blood Brothers that you don't control
(controlled by other players). Which means if two Chicago BB decks are at the
same table, controlling Jerry is crucial (otherwise he can steal all of your
blood each turn).
